attribution: The Atticus Project; CUAD: An Expert-Annotated NLP Dataset for Legal Contract Review (Hendrycks, Burns, Chen, Ball; NeurIPS 2021).
selection_reason: Full 35KB agreement with Basic/Additional Provisions, definitions, exhibits, cross-references, conditions and post-termination exceptions; selected for rule/evidence completeness rather than minimal cost or ease.
official_qa_extraction: One unchanged official document object in a version/data wrapper; original IDs, questions, answers and no-answer flags are preserved. JSON whitespace is locally formatted.
coordinate_system: Zero-based Unicode code points, half-open [start,end), against raw UTF-8 decoded complete TXT. No newline or Unicode normalization.
source_limitations: The official text references a separate August 24, 2017 Non-Disclosure Agreement that is not included; do not infer its full terms.
Additional Provisions 4.c refers to section 9 as No Agency Relationship, while the actual section heading is Independent Contractors; preserve source wording rather than silently normalizing it.
CUAD category answer spans are not a complete semantic gold standard for every clause condition or relation.
This step downloads/selects source material only; no paid model or application evaluation was run.
